fake 0.0.0-test - fake tool

Usage: fake <command> [args] [flags]

Commands:
  items            list items
  get              get item
  add              add item [write]
  schema           print the machine-readable CLI contract as JSON
  policy           show the effective policy and its file paths
  guard            Claude Code PreToolUse hook: deny tool calls that modify policy files (reads hook JSON on stdin)
  version          print the version
  help             show help

Global flags:
  --json                   print one JSON document
  --ndjson                 print one JSON object per line
  --fields <string>        comma-separated output fields
  --limit <int>            max items to return (default 50)
  --cursor <string>        continue from a next_cursor
  --max-chars <int>        cap stdout size; long text is truncated
  --dry-run                writes: show what would change, change nothing
  --confirm                writes: required to actually change data
  --timeout <string>       abort after this duration
  --help                   show help

Writes need --confirm (or --dry-run) and must be allowed by the policy file.
Run 'fake schema' for the full machine-readable contract.
